    sc=sorted(sep_cols); S=sr|set(sc)

    for bi in range(len(sr)+1):

    # rebuild bounds

        rstart = sr[bi-1]+1 if bi>0 else 0
        rend = sr[bi] if bi<len(sr) else h

def adj(cells):

def analyze(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sr=sorted([r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1]); sc=sorted([c for c in range(w) if len({r[c] for r in g})==1 and all(r[c]==g[0][c] for r in g)])
    R=[(0,sr[0]-1)]+[(sr[i]+1,sr[i+1]-1) for i in range(len(sr)-1)]+[(sr[-1]+1,h-1)]
    C=[(0,sc[0]-1)]+[(sc[j]+1,sc[j+1]-1) for j in range(len(sc)-1)]+[(sc[-1]+1,w-1)]
    res=[]
    for rr0,rr1 in R:
        for cc0,cc1 in C:
            pts={(r,c) for r in range(rr0,rr1+1) for c in range(cc0,cc1+1) if g[r][c]!=bg}
            col=g[next(iter(pts))[0]][next(iter(pts))[1]] if pts else None
            top=(min(r for r,c in pts)==rr0); bot=(max(r for r,c in pts)==rr1)
            lef=(min(c for _,c in pts)==cc0); rig=(max(c for _,c in pts)==cc1)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def blocks(g,bg):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    sr=sorted([r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1])
    scs=sorted([c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1])
    R=[(0,sr[0]-1)]+[(sr[i]+1,sr[i+1]-1) for i in range(len(sr)-1)]+[(sr[-1]+1,h-1)]
    C=[(0,scs[0]-1)]+[(scs[j]+1,scs[j+1]-1) for j in range(len(scs)-1)]+[(scs[-1]+1,w-1)]
    return R,C

    g=G[k+' input']; T=G[k+' output']
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    R,C=blocks(g,bg)
    print('===',k)
    for rr0,rr1 in R:
        for cc0,cc1 in C:
            pts=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(rr0,rr1+1) for c in range(cc0,cc1+1) if g[r][c]!=bg]
            col=pts[0][2] if pts else None
            top=min(r for r,c,_ in pts)==rr0; bot=max(r for r,c,_ in pts)==rr1
            lef=min(c for _,c,_ in pts)==cc0; rig=max(c for _,c,_ in pts)==cc1
            # does the filled block keep shape? check output structure: filled => all cells col; erased => bg elsewhere
            fill=all(T[r][c]==col for r in range(rr0,rr1+1) for c in range(cc0,cc1+1))
            erase=set()
            for r in range(rr0,rr1+1):
                for c in range(cc0,cc1+1):
                    if T[r][c]!=col and T[r][c]!=bg: erase.add((r,c))
            er=(not fill and len(erase)==0) if pts else False
            print('n=%d tb=%b %b %b l=%b %b FILL' % (len(pts),top,bot,lef,rig) if fill else ('n=%d tb=%b %b %b l=%b %b ERASE erase-cells=%s' %(len(pts),top,bot,lef,rig, sorted(erase)[:6])) , '')

    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def feats(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    srs,scs=sepinfo(gi)
    cnt_all=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row)
    bgc=cnt_all.most_common(1)[0][0]
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    rbs=[];prev=-1
    for s in srs+[h]:
        if prev+1<=s-1 and s-prev>1: rbs.append((prev+1,s-1))
        prev=s+1
    cbs=[];prev=-1
    for s in scs+[w]:
        if prev+1<=s-1 and s-prev>1: cbs.append((prev+1,s-1))
        prev=s+1
    res=[]
    for (r0,r1) in rbs:
        for (c0,c1) in cbs:
            sub=[[gi[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
            cnt=Counter(x for row in sub for x in row)
            ncs=[c for c in cnt if c!=bgc]
            if len(ncs)!=1: continue
            nc=ncs[0]
            pts=[(i,j) for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1) if gi[i][j]==nc]
            H=W=None
            rel=[(p[0]-r0,p[1]-c0) for p in pts]; h2,w2=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
            ffill=filled=all(go[i][j]==nc for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1))
            def adj(a,b): return abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1])==1
            horiz=any(adj(a,b) for a in rel for b in rel if a<b and a[0]==b[0])
            vert=any(adj(a,b) for a in rel for b in rel if a<b and a[1]==b[1])
            diag=any(abs(a[0]-b[0])==1 and abs(a[1]-b[1])==1 for a in rel for b in rel if a<b)
            edges=[(a[0],a[1]) for a in rel if a[0]==0 or a[0]==h2-1 or a[1]==0 or a[1]==w2-1]
            res.append(dict(n=len(rel),hh=horiz,vv=vert,di=diag,nedges=len(edges),
                            filled=ffill,h=h2,w=w2,rel=rel,tag='FILL' if ffill else 'KEEP'))
    return res
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print('====',k)
    for r_ in feats(k): print(r_['n'],'h',r_['hh'],'v',r_['vv'],'d',r_['di'],'e',r_['nedges'],'->',r_['tag'])

d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def analyze(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    srs,scs=sepinfo(gi)
    cnt_all=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row)
    bgc=cnt_all.most_common(1)[0][0]
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    sep_col = gi[srs[0]][0] if srs else gi[scs[0]][0] if scs else None
    rbnds=[];prev=-1
    for s in srs+[h]:
        if prev+1<s: rbnds.append((prev+1,s-1))
        prev=s+1
    cbnds=[];prev=-1
    for s in scs+[w]:
        if prev+1<s: cbnds.append((prev+1,s-1))
        prev=s+1
    res=[]
    for (r0,r1) in rbnds:
        for (c0,c1) in cbnds:
            blk=[[gi[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
            colc=Counter(x for row in blk for x in row if x!=bgc)
            if not colc: continue
            nc=colc.most_common(1)[0][0]
            pts=[(i,j) for i in range(r1-r0+1) for j in range(c1-c0+1) if blk[i][j]==nc]
            filled=all(go[i][j]==nc for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1))
            rel=tuple(sorted((i,j) for i,j in pts))
            # noise cells count, largest comp (8-conn within block)
            cs=comps_of(blk,nc)
            info=dict(n=len(pts),maxcomp=max(len(c) for c in cs),sumcomp=sum(len(c) for c in cs),comps=len(cs),
                      H=r1-r0+1,W=c1-c0+1,filled=filled,rel=rel,k=k)
            res.append(info)
    return res,bgc

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    res,bg=analyze(k)
    print('====',k,'bg',bg)
    for r_ in res:
        print(f"{'FILL' if r_['filled'] else 'KEEP'} n={r_['n']} area={r_['H']*r_['W']} maxcomp={r_['maxcomp']} rel={r_['rel']}")

def comps_of(blk,col):
    h=len(blk); w=len(blk[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if blk[i][j]==col and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)];seen.add((i,j));comp=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop();comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        for dx in(-1,0,1):
                            yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and blk[yy][xx]==col and (yy,xx) not in seen:

    return out

def parse(k):

            if prev+1<s: bs.append((prev+1,s-1)); prev=s+1
        return bs
    rbs=bounds(srs,h); cbds=bounds(scs,w)
    res=[]
    for r0,r1 in rbs:
        for c0,c1 in cbds:
            blk=[[gi[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
            colc=Counter(x for row in blk for x in row)
            others=[c for c in colc if c!=bgc and c!=sepcol]

            pts=[(i,j) for i in range(len(blk)) for j in range(len(blk[0])) if blk[i][j]==nc]
            filled=all(go[i][j]==nc for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1))

            # gap: number of empty rows/cols inside bbox

import itertools
def blocks(i):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    srs=[x for x in range(h) if len(set(gi[x]))==1]; scs=[y for y in range(w) if len({gi[x][y] for x in range(h)})==1]
    def bounds(seps,nmax):
        bs=[];prev=-1
        for s in seps+[nmax]:
            if prev+1<s: bs.append((prev+1,s-1)); prev=s+1
        return bs
    rbs=bounds(srs,h); cbds=bounds(scs,w)
    out={}
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rbs):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cbds):
            blk=[[gi[a][b] for b in range(c0,c1+1)] for a in range(r0,r1+1)]
            colc=Counter(x for r in blk for x in r); others=[c for c in colc if c!=bgc and c!=gi[srs[0]][0]]
            if len(others)!=1: continue
            nc=others[0]
            pts=[(a,b) for a in range(len(blk)) for b in range(len(blk[0])) if blk[a][b]==nc]
            outblk=[[go[a][b] for b in range(c0,c1+1)] for a in range(r0,r1+1)]
            filled=all(outblk[a][b]==nc for a in range(len(blk)) for b in range(len(blk[0])))
            comp=frozenset(pts)
            out[(ri,ci)]=(dict(n=len(pts),h=len(blk),w=len(blk[0]),area=len(blk)*len(blk[0]),
                                 d=len(pts)/(len(blk)*len(blk[0])),
                                 filled=filled,comp=comp,pts=pts))
    return out,bgc
for i in range(1,7):

from collections import Counter
def feats(i):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    srs=[x for x in range(h) if len(set(gi[x]))==1]; scs=[y for y in range(w) if len({gi[x][y] for x in range(h)})==1]
    def bounds(seps,nmax):
        bs=[];prev=-1
        for s in seps+[nmax]: bs.append((prev+1,s-1)); prev=s+1
        return bs
    rb=bounds(srs,h); cb=bounds(scs,w)
    res=[]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rb):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cb):
            blk=[[gi[a][b] for b in range(c0,c1+1)] for a in range(r0,r1+1)]
            cc=Counter(x for r in blk for x in r); cand=[c for c in cc if c!=bgc]
            if not cand: continue
            nc=max(cand,key=lambda c:cc[c]); n=sum(1 for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if gi[a][b]==nc)
            pts=[(a-r0,b-c0) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if gi[a][b]==nc]
            seen=set(); szs=[]
            for p in pts:
                if p in seen: continue
                st=[p];s=0
                while st:
                    q=st.pop()
                    if q in seen: continue
                    seen.add(q); s+=1
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nn=(q[0]+dr,q[1]+dc)
                        if nn in pts: st.append(nn)
                szs.append(s)
            res.append(dict(n=n,maxsz=max(szs),comps=len(szs),h=r1-r0+1,w=c1-c0+1,
                           fill=all(go[a][b]==nc for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1))))
    return res
T=[feats(i) for i in range(1,9)]

    def bounds(seps,nmax):
        bs=[];prev=-1
        for s in seps+[nmax]: bs.append((prev+1,s-1)); prev=s+1
        return bs
    rb=bounds(srs,h); cb=bounds(scs,w)
    res=[]
